text:
Riley (Account Exec): Quick ask — Kestrel Payments (new SMB) hit a one-time onboarding surge and the May invoice is $9,150. They're asking for a partial surcharge waiver to keep momentum. Sales asks to convert $5,000 into a time-limited onboarding rebate applied over next 2 invoices. Thoughts?

Priya (Finance): Need numbers. Can you paste the invoice split and confirm if Sales will require a written commitment? Also state whether rebate is refundable and impact to revenue recognition (we prefer amortize).

Riley (Account Exec): Split: 
```
- Gen tokens: $5,400
- Embeddings: $2,000
- Support (on-call): $750
- Data transfer / infra burst: $1,000
- Total: $9,150
Proposal: $5,000 rebate -> $2,500 applied to Jun invoice, $2,500 applied to Jul invoice. Conditional on a signed 3-month pilot (min $3k/mo).
```

Dana (RevOps): If we do this, put a clause that rebate voids if they downgrade before pilot end. Also we should tag the customer record so renewal/sales ops sees the rebate window. Forecasting note: treat the rebate as contra-revenue and amortize over the two months.

Priya (Finance): Agree on amortization. Approve up to $4,500 provided: 1) executed 3-month pilot addendum, 2) rebate coded to GL account "promo_rebates_may" and 3) product confirms no SLA change requested.

Riley (Account Exec): Understood. Sales can secure the 3-month min commit and won't request SLA changes — they only want the rebate to stay.

Tom (Legal): I'll prepare a short amendment: rebate schedule, clause that rebate is non-refundable and forfeited if commit not signed within 7 days, and rollback language if customer materially breaches. Send to legal@redwood for countersign once signed.

Riley (Account Exec): Thanks. If finance confirms the $4,500 cap, I'll push for signature today.

billing-bot: Draft credit memo created: CM-2026-117 (amount: $4,500) 1 status: awaiting finance approval.

Priya (Finance): Final: approved up to $4,500 contingent on signed amendment, amortize over Jun+Jul, record GL entry. Billing: please hold off until legal confirms signed PDF. :white_check_mark:

Dana (RevOps): I'll add the renewal trigger and rebate flag in the CRM and block autopilot churn emails until the pilot end date.

Riley (Account Exec): Great, will update thread when signed.
